LESSON: WRITING 3.3.1 SEQUENCING IDEAS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.3: Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: when using a vehicle) on the theme, 1. How can you ensure your ideas flow in communication?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify connectors in texts for effective communication
2. use connectors to sequence ideas logically in a paragraph for comprehension
3. enjoy writing texts using connectors for effective communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: WRITING 3.3.1 SEQUENCING IDEAS
This lesson teaches Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas for Grade 5 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify connectors in texts for effective communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use connectors to sequence ideas logically in a paragraph for comprehension
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. enjoy writing texts using connectors for effective communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas above.
2. Explain Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. when using a vehicle) on the theme, 1. How can you ensure your ideas flow in communication?
2. Why do we use connectors in writing?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify connectors in texts for effective communication
2. use connectors to sequence ideas logically in a paragraph for comprehension
3. enjoy writing texts using connectors for effective communication
